messages.text: Who's the man standing in your attic window?
Your delivery driver. Food's at your door.
I live alone. Nobody goes up there.
Little round window above your porch. Light's on.
Now he's pointing down. At your front door.
I can hear him walking. Right above my bed.
Lock your bedroom door. I'm calling the police.
Wait. Your front door just opened.
He said thanks. He orders under your name every week.

end: The police searched my attic. They found 11 receipts with my name on them.
